parallel.requirements: The parent recognized ESM .mjs output, no external npm modules, manual argparse compatibility, black-box probing of DeepDiff string output, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned implementation and delivery while a six-child workflow owned behavioral probing dimensions plus a planned critique phase.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote Python repr, splitlines, difflib SequenceMatcher, unified diff, DeepDiff result formatting, argv/argparse helpers, index, and test1.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Output files were written directly into /output and artifact validation later copied test1.mjs plus library modules successfully.
parallel.verification: The parent ran targeted probes and began a broad differential suite, but that suite ended with exit 137 before reporting a pass/fail summary.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow aggregate result was null and killed, four probe children never returned final structured output, and official evaluation still failed 3 of 70 samples.

serial.requirements: The single agent recognized the same ESM, .mjs, argv, output parity, no-dependency, black-box probing, and /output requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor sequentially owned probing, implementation, local testing, fixes, and delivery without delegation or subagent handoffs.
serial.implementation: It wrote pycompat, difflib, deepdiff, argparse modules, index files, test1.mjs, and local test/fuzz harnesses in /output.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial tree was assembled directly in /output and artifact validation copied test1.mjs, tests, and all library modules successfully.
serial.verification: The serial run completed a 60-case replay differential suite with pass=60 fail=0, then began randomized line and Unicode fuzzing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run timed out during the later spicy Unicode fuzzer, and official evaluation still failed 3 of 70 samples despite local replay success.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the required ESM .mjs, manual argv, output byte parity, no external dependencies, black-box probing, and /output placement.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same requirements from the identical prompt and applied them in a single-agent implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements recognition difference is evidenced; both failures came after broadly similar requirement coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral discovery across six workflow probers and kept implementation ownership in the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing, implementation, fixes, and verification in one continuous owner.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel decomposition created child lifecycle and shared scratch-space boundaries that serial did not have.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were dimension-specific and shared a common probe helper path, with children expected to return structured specs to a workflow digest.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained probe findings in one context and did not need child brief, handoff, or aggregate-result interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced inter-agent handoff and shared helper interfaces; serial avoided those interfaces entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a module hierarchy for Python printing, difflib, DeepDiff, CLI parsing, argv recovery, and the entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a similar hierarchy with pycompat, difflib, deepdiff, argparse, and the entry point.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation goals converged, but the parallel implementation proceeded while several delegated specs were still incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow journal returned only two child results and the workflow state ended killed with result null.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it consumed its own findings directly and moved into local test execution.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the aggregate result lifecycle for most child work, while serial had no comparable join point.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children shared /workspace/probe and collided on helper file naming before switching to namespaced files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its /output tree directly and had no subagents sharing a scratch helper namespace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel incurred same-file scratch collisions; serial's single actor did not have concurrent writer collisions.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel began a broad differential suite but it was killed with exit 137 before a summary; official evaluation later failed 3 of 70.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed a 60-case differential suite with pass=60 fail=0, then began fuzzing; official evaluation also failed 3 of 70.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger local acceptance evidence before timeout, while parallel's broad suite was interrupted without a completed summary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used eight workflow child logs, 394197 workflow child tokens, and hit the 2399-second agent timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and also hit the 2399-second agent timeout after starting a later fuzzer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the run budget, but parallel spent substantial budget on child workflow breadth and stalled retries before final verification finished.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail because the current completed evaluations for both modes report solution_passed false and 67/70 samples. The solutions differed materially in process: the parallel run launched broad child probing and lost its aggregate workflow result before timeout, whereas the serial run completed a focused replay suite and then timed out on later fuzzing. The evidence supports parallel-specific adverse coordination episodes, but not an outcome differential, because the serial artifact reached the same official score and also timed out.
parallel_contributors: Six-child probing workflow with retries ended killed and result null before most child specs were aggregated.
Shared /workspace/probe helper naming caused same-file child write collisions and rerouting.
serial_contributors: Single trajectory completed a 60-case differential replay suite with pass=60 fail=0 before later fuzz timeout.
No subagent handoffs or shared child scratch collisions were present.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both artifacts still failed 3 of 70 official samples; the allowed files do not expose the exact failing test cases.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator completed for both modes; external cache and log paths in status were not followed under the input boundary.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse process patterns without an official outcome difference
